name: Aakash Rajput
bio:
I got two jobs, flew to another city, found a new one, and worked on Dhurandhar, all before seeing my degree.

I’m young, I'm motivated, and I'm inspired every day by the greats. 
I’m here to learn relentlessly, make work that matters, and contribute to taking Indian creativity to new heights.
There’s a long way to go. That’s exactly what excites me.

projects.title: DHURANDHAR
projects.description: Worked mainly on the behind-the-scenes content for Dhurandhar, editing production footage into polished BTS pieces. I also contributed to some simple editing work for the film itself and was credited in the movie’s official credits.

projects.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
projects.description: Worked on the promotional campaign for Spider-Man: Brand New Day ahead of the film’s release. My work included editing short-form promotional footage, footage cleanup and removals, VFX, online finishing, subtitles and text elements, and preparing the final deliverables. I also edited footage from the film’s premiere as part of the campaign content.
